title: The Cycle Weaving Course
summary: A course in winding qi into rings and wheels that bind a foe strike twice and return to the hand.

title: A Course in Rising Again
summary: A course in recovering at once from a fall or a broken guard and in turning mending qi through the wounds of an ally.

title: The Second Handbook of Husks
summary: A second handbook for students who can shed a shell of qi: it builds husks that guard and burst and decoys to step out of.

title: A Course in Past Knowing
summary: A course in using the faint memory of other lives to read a foe and place a step before it is needed.
